spec.description: Angry Duck, the Kubernetes image lifecycle manager: delivery, rescue and repair, mirror and registries, disk cleanup and its own runtime. Pick data source → cluster; click any node or image to focus.

spec.title: Workers Up

    or on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, kind, component) (
      label_replace(kube_pod_owner{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", owner_kind="Job"}, "job_name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")
      * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, job_name) group_left (kind, component)
      group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, job_name, kind, component) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_job_owner{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", owner_kind="CronJob"}, "kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.+)"), "component", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")))
    or on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, kind, component) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_owner{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}, "kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.+)"), "component", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))
  )
)
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, container) group_left
  max by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, container) (
    (kube_pod_container_status_running{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1)
    or 2 * kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason="ContainerCreating"}
    or 3 * kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason=~"ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull"}
    or 4 * kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason="CreateContainerError"}
    or 5 * kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason!~"ContainerCreating|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerError"}
    or 6 * (kube_pod_container_status_terminated{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1)
  )
) == 1) * 0 + 1)
  or (sum by (node) (angryduck_controller_spread_node_missing_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}) * 0 + 2)
  or (sum by (node) (angryduck_controller_spread_transfer_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}) * 0 + 3)
  or (sum by (node) (angryduck_controller_rescue_stuck_pods{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}) * 0 + 4)
  or (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_broken_image{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}) * 0 + 5)
)

spec.title: Nodes Receiving
spec.description: Node and image pairs still waiting, transferring or finalizing, across running spreads.

spec.title: Bytes Still Missing
spec.description: Bytes the nodes still lack, summed over every running spread.

spec.title: Last Spread Took
spec.description: From the preheat to the last node registering the image, for the last spread that completed.

spec.title: Peer Share of Spread Bytes
spec.description: Share of the bytes spreads delivered that came from a peer instead of the registry, in the time range.

spec.title: Expired Spreads in Range
spec.description: Spreads that ran out of time before every eligible node had the image.

spec.title: Spread Status
spec.description: One row per image being spread: nodes per state, layers peers can serve (held), only coming from the registry (pulling) or held by nobody (missing), and the bytes nodes still lack. Click an image to focus on it.

spec.title: Images Stuck
spec.description: Images some node can't pull right now (ImagePullBackOff, ErrImagePull). Angry Duck rescues them from peers.

spec.title: Spread Download by Path
spec.description: Bytes per second nodes received for spreads, from the registry or from peers. The more from peers, the less the registry serves.

spec.title: Spread Throughput by Path
spec.description: Bytes per second of transfer time, per path: how fast a blob comes in while it is coming in.

spec.title: Nodes per Spread State
spec.description: Node and image pairs per state, summed over running spreads.

spec.title: Spread Transfers by Result
spec.description: Blob transfers that ended, per minute, by path and result. cancelled: another copy won the race or a restart replaced it; present: the node already had it; upstream: a stream broke because its source stopped (not the receiver's fault).

spec.title: Spreads Finished by Result
spec.description: Spreads that ended, per minute: complete (every eligible node has it), superseded (a newer tag came), expired.

spec.title: Spread Finalizes by Result
spec.description: Nodes registering a spread image, per minute, by result.

spec.title: Nodes Still Missing
spec.description: Layers and bytes each node still lacks, per image, while its spread runs. Click to focus.

spec.title: Transfers Running
spec.description: Blob transfers running now: the receiving node, where the blob comes from and its size. At most two per node.

spec.expr: max by (image, node, path, source, blob) (angryduck_controller_spread_transfer_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"})

spec.title: Seed Pulls by Result
spec.description: Whole-image pulls from the registry the controller ordered on seed nodes, per minute. cancelled: a peer delivered first.

spec.title: Average Seed Pull Duration per Node
spec.description: Seconds per successful seed pull, per node.

spec.expr:
sum by (node) (rate(angryduck_worker_pull_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="success"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(sum by (node) (rate(angryduck_worker_pulls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Broken Images
spec.description: Images registered on a node that can't start a container. The node repairs them in place, from peers first, then the registry.

spec.title: Seed Registry Download per Node
spec.description: Bytes the latest image seeded on each node lacked: what that seed downloaded from the registry.

spec.title: Seed Timeouts & Ranking
spec.description: Slow seed pulls cancelled in favor of peers, and how seeds were ranked: by layers, or the repo and utilization fallbacks. Per minute.

spec.title: Transfers Coming In per Node
spec.description: Blobs coming in on each node right now, by path.

spec.title: Spread Bytes Served per Node
spec.description: Bytes per second each node served to peers for spreads: the busiest sources.

spec.title: Preheated Containers Running
spec.description: Running containers from repos recently preheated, per repo.

spec.title: Seed Pull Orders by Result
spec.description: Seed pull orders the controller sent to workers, per minute.

spec.title: Propagations Finished by Result
spec.description: Whole-image propagations that ended, per minute: complete, superseded or expired.

spec.title: Propagation Transfers by Result
spec.description: Image transfers ordered while propagating, per minute.

spec.title: Nodes per Propagation State
spec.description: Node and image pairs per state, summed over running propagations.

spec.title: Images Fetched for Propagation
spec.description: Images workers fetched from peers to propagate them, per minute, by result.

spec.title: Spreads Running
spec.description: Images being spread to the nodes right now.

spec.title: Images Stuck
spec.description: Images some node can't pull right now.

spec.title: Pods Stuck
spec.description: Pods waiting on an image their node can't pull.

spec.title: Rescues Running
spec.description: Rescues in progress now.

spec.title: Failed Rescues in Range
spec.description: Rescues that failed, or found no peer holding the image (no_source) or no worker on the node (no_target), in the time range.

spec.title: Broken Images
spec.description: Images registered on a node that can't start a container.

spec.title: Failed Repairs in Range
spec.description: Repairs that couldn't get a missing piece from any peer or the registry. Retried at the next check.

spec.title: Stuck Pulls
spec.description: Each node and image that pods can't pull: how many pods wait, whether a rescue is running for it, and failed rescue attempts in a row. Click a node or image to focus.

spec.expr:
group by (node, image) (angryduck_controller_rescue_stuck_pods{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image", in_flight="1"})
or (group by (node, image) (angryduck_controller_rescue_stuck_pods{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}) * 0)

spec.title: Broken Images
spec.description: Images registered on a node that can't start a container right now. The node keeps repairing them until it can.

spec.title: Pods Waiting on These Images
spec.description: Pods whose containers wait on a stuck or broken image, with kubelet's reason (from kube-state-metrics).

spec.expr:
max by (namespace, pod, node, image, reason) (
  label_replace(
    kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason=~"ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerError"}
    * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, container) group_left (image_spec)
    max by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, container, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}),
    "image", "$1", "image_spec", "(.+)")
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (node)
  max by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
)
and on (image) (group by (image) (angryduck_controller_rescue_stuck_pods{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", image=~"$image"}) or group by (image) (angryduck_worker_broken_image{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", image=~"$image"}))

spec.title: Stuck Images per Node
spec.description: Images each node can't pull. Click a series to focus on its node.

spec.title: Mirror Hit Ratio
spec.description: Share of containerd's content requests the mirror answered from this node or a peer, in the time range. The rest went to the registry.

spec.title: Rescues by Result
spec.description: What the controller decided for stuck pulls, per minute: success, failure, no_source (no peer has it), no_target (no worker on the node), pull_policy_always.

spec.title: Images Fetched from Peers
spec.description: Images workers fetched from peers to rescue a stuck pull, per minute, by result.

spec.title: Layers by Delivery Method
spec.description: Layers moved between nodes, per minute: present (already there), blob (compressed layer) or snapshot (unpacked layer, the last resort).

spec.title: Broken Images per Node
spec.description: Images on each node that can't start a container.

spec.title: Repairs by Result
spec.description: Broken images repaired in place, or not (retried at the next check), per minute.

spec.title: Repair Download by Source
spec.description: Bytes per second repairs fetched, from a peer or the registry.

spec.title: Repair Orders by Result
spec.description: Repair orders the controller sent when a container failed to start on a broken image (CreateContainerError), per minute: sent, failed, no_worker.

spec.title: Rescue Traffic per Node
spec.description: Bytes per second each node served to or received from peers for rescues.

spec.title: Pinned Snapshots per Node
spec.description: Snapshots each node keeps pinned for a retry.

spec.title: Leftovers Removed
spec.description: Leftovers removed per minute: temporary snapshots and images, expired pins, and temporary import names a killed worker left behind.

spec.title: Registry Traffic Avoided
spec.description: Bytes nodes got from a peer instead of the registry in the time range: mirror, spreads, rescues and repairs.

spec.expr: sum (label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "mirror", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "spread", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__range]), "via", "rescue", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "repair", "", ""))

spec.title: Failed Rescues in a Row
spec.description: Failed attempts in a row per node and image, for pairs with at least one failure.

spec.title: Mirror Hit Ratio
spec.description: Share of containerd's content requests the mirror answered from this node or a peer, in the time range.

spec.title: Mirror Requests / s
spec.description: Content requests containerd sends to the mirror.

spec.title: Mirror Errors in Range
spec.description: Mirror requests that ended in an error, in the time range.

spec.title: Images Gone from Registry
spec.description: Images on nodes that their registry answered missing or denied for.

spec.title: Last Copies
spec.description: Images gone from their registry that only one node still holds. Once it goes, nothing can pull them again.

spec.title: Registries in Trouble
spec.description: Registries that refused Angry Duck's credentials or couldn't be reached for some image at the last check.

spec.title: Registry Status
spec.description: Distinct images held on nodes, per registry, by the registry's answer at the last origin check. A whole registry turning denied usually means its pull secret changed.

spec.title: Images the Registry No Longer Serves
spec.description: Images whose registry answered missing or denied, how many nodes still hold a copy, and how many pod containers run them (from kube-state-metrics). One copy left is the last one.

spec.expr:
count by (image) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}, "image", "$1", "image_spec", "(.+)"))
and on (image) group by (image) (angryduck_controller_origin_unavailable{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", image=~"$image"})

spec.title: Mirror Requests by Result
spec.description: Content requests containerd sent to the mirror, by result: local, peer, miss (went to the registry), error.

spec.title: Node Status
spec.description: One row per node: worker version and uptime, whether it follows containerd's events, what is stuck or broken there, disk cleanup, mirror hits and peer traffic in the time range, memory and containerd load. Click a node to focus on it.

spec.expr: time() - max by (node, version) (angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"})

max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
+ (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) * 0)

sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer"}[$__range]))
/
(sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (node) (label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "mirror", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "spread", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__range]), "via", "rescue", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "repair", "", ""))

sum by (node) (label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_peer_served_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range]), "via", "mirror", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="served"}[$__range]), "via", "spread", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="served"}[$__range]), "via", "rescue", "", ""))

spec.title: Mirror Hit Ratio per Node
spec.description: Share of each node's mirror requests answered from the node itself or a peer.

spec.expr:
sum by (node) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(sum by (node) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Mirror Bytes by Source
spec.description: Bytes per second the mirror served, from this node or a peer.

spec.title: Bytes Served to Peers per Node
spec.description: Bytes per second each node served to other nodes: mirror, spreads and rescues together.

spec.expr: sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_peer_served_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]), "via", "mirror", "", "") or label_replace(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="served"}[$__rate_interval]), "via", "spread", "", "") or label_replace(rate(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="served"}[$__rate_interval]), "via", "rescue", "", "")) > 0

spec.title: Mirror Requests by Kind
spec.description: Mirror requests per kind (blob, manifest) and result.

spec.title: Images per Registry Answer
spec.description: Distinct images on fresh nodes, by their registry's answer at the last check.

spec.title: Origin Checks by Answer
spec.description: Manifest HEAD requests the controller sent to registries, per minute, by answer.

spec.title: Images Gone from Registry
spec.description: Images their registry no longer serves, by answer.

spec.title: Nodes Cleaning
spec.description: Nodes whose disk went above GC_HIGH and are removing unused images until GC_LOW.

spec.title: Nodes Stalled
spec.description: Nodes above GC_HIGH where removing images frees nothing: the disk is full of something else.

spec.title: Removable Now
spec.description: Images the cleanup could remove right now, across tiers.

spec.title: Registry Traffic Avoided
spec.description: Bytes per second nodes got without the registry, by how: the mirror (from this node or a peer), spreads, rescues and repairs from peers.

spec.title: Images Removed in Range
spec.description: Images the cleanup removed in the time range.

spec.title: Removal Errors in Range
spec.description: Removals that failed in the time range.

spec.title: Images Coming Back
spec.description: Images that came back within an hour of the cleanup removing them: something still uses them, so each removal cost a re-pull.

spec.title: Cleanup Status
spec.description: One row per node: cleanup state, images removable now per tier, images removed and failed removals in the time range, and images that came back. Click a node to focus on it.

spec.expr:
max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
+ (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) * 0)

spec.title: Cleanup Timeline
spec.description: Cleanup state per node: idle; cleaning (disk above GC_HIGH, removing unused images until GC_LOW); stalled (removals stopped freeing space). Click a row to focus on its node.

spec.expr:
max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
+ (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) * 0)

spec.title: Images Removed by Tier
spec.description: Images removed per minute, by tier: old (unused for a while), pressure (disk above GC_HIGH), rollback (a newest tag, only under pressure), error.

spec.title: Removable Images by Tier
spec.description: Images removable right now, by tier.

spec.title: Images Removed per Node
spec.description: Images removed per minute on each node.

spec.title: Images Coming Back After Removal
spec.description: Images that came back within an hour of the cleanup removing them, and how many times.

spec.title: Images Removed
spec.description: Images the cleanup removed, from which node, when and by which tier: old (unused for GC_UNUSED_FOR_S), pressure (disk above GC_HIGH), rollback (a newest tag, only under pressure).

spec.expr: max by (node, image, tier) (last_over_time(angryduck_worker_gc_image_removed_timestamp_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"}[$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Registry Downloads
spec.description: Bytes per second Angry Duck fetched from registries: spread layers no peer had yet and pieces of broken images no peer had. Seed pulls go through containerd and are counted on the Delivery tab.

spec.title: Images Coming Up for Removal
spec.description: Unused images the age rule will remove, from which node and in how long. Disk pressure removes them sooner, oldest first. Images kept for rollback are not listed.

spec.expr: min by (node, image, tier) (angryduck_worker_gc_image_removal_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$image"})

spec.title: Workers
spec.description: Worker processes reporting.

spec.title: Controllers
spec.description: Controller processes reporting. Angry Duck runs one.

spec.title: Versions Running
spec.description: Distinct Angry Duck versions running. More than one: a rollout is in progress.

spec.expr: count(count by (version) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Restarts in Range
spec.description: Processes that started again within the time range.

spec.expr:
round((sum(changes(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+ (sum(changes(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

spec.title: Busiest Worker Memory
spec.description: Memory the hungriest worker really holds (rss_anon).

spec.title: containerd Calls / min
spec.description: gRPC calls all selected workers make to containerd.

spec.title: Process Status
spec.description: One row per Angry Duck process: component, node, version, uptime, memory it really holds (rss_anon), live Go heap and CPU (from cAdvisor). Click a node to focus on it.

spec.expr: time() - max by (pod, component, node, version) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval]))
and on (pod) group by (pod) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))

spec.title: Memory Held per Process
spec.description: Memory each process really holds (rss_anon): the number to size limits against. Container working set also counts the process's own code, which the kernel can drop.

spec.title: CPU Usage per Process
spec.description: CPU cores each process uses (from cAdvisor).

spec.expr:
sum by (component, node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval])
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (component, node)
  group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, component, node) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"})))

spec.title: Bytes Streamed While Still Arriving per Node
spec.description: Bytes per second each node sent to peers from blobs it was still receiving itself (part of what it served). A node streaming is a link in a chain: the bytes move on as they arrive.

spec.title: Stream Orders
spec.description: Peer transfers ordered per minute from a node still receiving the blob itself. Beside "Spread Transfers by Result": result=upstream there counts streams that broke because their source stopped.

spec.title: Slow-Chain Guard
spec.description: What the guard did about late transfers, per minute. race: a late registry pull raced from the registry. replaced: a late transfer restarted from another holder. kept: the receiver judged its own transfer finishes sooner (or declined a second copy that would only split its link). Mostly kept, no replaced: nodes are slow on their own link, not behind someone else.

spec.title: Angry Duck

spec.name: datasource
spec.label: Data source
spec.description: Prometheus or Mimir data source with Angry Duck's metrics (and kube-state-metrics and cAdvisor, for pods and CPU).

spec.name: cluster
spec.label: Cluster
spec.description: Cluster (k8s_source_cluster). "All" also matches setups without that label.

spec.name: node
spec.label: Node
spec.description: Nodes to show. Click a node anywhere to pick it.

spec.name: image
spec.label: Image
spec.description: Images Angry Duck was busy with in the time range: spreading, stuck, broken, gone from their registry, or coming back after cleanup. Pick one for the Image tab, or click an image anywhere.
